title: [review] routing.py:246: routes() loses prefix rou
description: The routes() method uses rt.prefix as the dict key but RouteTargets with different prefix_len can have identical canonical prefixes (e.g., 2001:db8::/32 and 2001:db8::/48 both canonicalize to 2001:db8::). When iterating, later entries overwrite earlier ones, causing silent data loss. The items() method exists as a workaround but callers of routes() may not expect this behavior.
